$comment: Route file of the ai host pack, read by the kit's paperflow-route hook. keywords: whole-word regular-expression fragments that mark a prompt as work on code that calls a language model; a project adds its own under routing.hosts.ai.keywords. No live lane: the decision is proved with a fake reply first, the real call last.
loop: red - a unit test with a fake model reply, seen failing on its assertion
green - the smallest code that passes it
e2e - the real call (verb e2e), model ids and parameters looked up in skill claude-api
